result.topic_en: Optimisation of the self-inductance of a circular coil, E = 2πr m M log(8r/(a e e)), with respect to the wire cross-section radius a under a fixed total cross-section constraint, leading to log(h/a^3) = 3/2 and a = 8r/e^{7/2}; side calculations of logarithms and a series for log x.

methods.what: Self-induction energy/coefficient of a circular coil of radius r with wire cross-section radius a
Constraint: total cross-section of giving and receiving windings
Elimination of m to express E as function of a
Maximisation of a^2 log(h/a^3) by setting derivative to zero
Optimal radius expressed via coil radius
